intro: Book a table online or give us a call. We confirm every booking by message or phone; for groups larger than [N] people, please contact us directly.

notes.title: Confirmation
notes.text: A booking made through the form is valid once we confirm it by message or phone, usually within [N] hours.

notes.title: Running late
notes.text: We hold the table for [15] minutes after the booked time. If you are running late, let us know.

notes.title: Larger groups
notes.text: For more than [N] people or booking the whole restaurant, see private parties.

notes.title: Allergies
notes.text: Note any allergies or special requests in the comments and the kitchen will be prepared.

notes.title: Cancellation
notes.text: If you can't make it, please let us know at least [N] hours in advance.
